meta.title: Fix provider initialization reuse
meta.body_summary: Cache provider instances for reuse in OpenAI-compatible API server endpoints to reduce repeated initialization overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit caching addition; merged within minutes by maintainer before bot review; no performance evidence required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 36 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume, confined to one file. It represents a typical micro-optimization PR, and the successful low-friction merge is fully consistent with the minimal scope.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot flagged thread-safety vulnerability, potential cache key collisions using __name__, and code duplication; all suggestions were non-blocking and not addressed before merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching provider instances reduces overhead of repeated initialization on every request.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Caching instance creation in an API server is a low-risk change well within agent capability; merge proceeded immediately without human pushback despite bot suggestions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed the code and suggested improvements for cache key collision, DRY refactoring, and thread safety; maintainer did not provide separate manual detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions pytest fails with missing cloudscraper module; no benchmark, profiler, or numeric performance claim to reproduce.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions occurred; PR merged as-is without any follow-up fix.

core_change_summary.description: In webscout/Provider/OPENAI/api.py, added module-level caches provider_instances and tti_provider_instances, and helper functions get_provider_instance and get_tti_provider_instance to reuse provider instances instead of creating new ones on every request.
change_trajectory: Single commit (f27dd91b) adds caching logic and updates chat_completions/image_generations to use cached instances.

review_signals.summary: Pull Request Overview summarizing caching change with no blocking comments.
Using class __name__ as cache key can lead to collisions; suggest fully qualified name.
Nearly identical implementations of get_provider_instance and get_tti_provider_instance; refactor shared logic.
Module-level cache access isn't thread-safe; consider adding a lock.

collaboration_trajectory: Single commit by maintainer (OEvortex) caching provider instances.
PR merged within ~1.5 minutes of creation, before bot review was submitted.
Copilot bot posted non-blocking review comments after merge.
